title: Ôn luyện Từ vựng thi vào 10 số 49: Our experiences (Set 1)

lessons.contentHtml:
Hãy cùng học các từ vựng thuộc chủ điểm Our experiences (Set 1) ngay nhé!


Nhấn ᐸ / ᐳ để chuyển sang từ khác và 🔊 để nghe phát âm.

Bạn nên đọc kĩ nghĩa, ví dụ và nghe phát âm của tất cả các từ vựng trước khi nhấn "Next" để chuyển sang luyện tập ở mức nhận biết.

Hãy cùng luyện tập các từ vựng bạn vừa học nhé!

(Nhấn "Next" để chuyển sang các bài tập tiếp theo.)

Read the text and do the following tasks.

My summer school trip to the coast was unforgettable. We toured a local fishing village and learned how to mend nets. The boat trip out to the deeper waters was exhilarating - the waves were huge! And of course, we sampled the local speciality: grilled seafood right on the beach.  It was the perfect end to a fantastic experience.

Jake: The water was so clear, and I saw a beautiful 12.2  full of colorful fish. It felt like swimming in a different world. Emma: That’s awesome! Did you do anything else exciting? Jake: Yeah! We got to explore the 12.3  with a guide. There were old shipwrecks and so many sea creatures I had never seen before. Emma: That must have been unforgettable! Did you experience any local culture? Jake: Yes! The locals invited us to watch a 12.4  in the evening. It was incredible - everyone wore traditional costumes and played drums.
